# relgap registry

relgap's registry has one file per tool, registry/&lt;name&gt;.yaml, for tools whose versions or
changelogs need rules that auto-discovery gets wrong. The schema is https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/schemas/registry-v1.json.

## Usage

```sh
relgap registry <command>
```

The [global flags](/cli/global-flags) work with every command.

## Examples

```sh
relgap registry lint registry/terraform.yaml
relgap registry test terraform 1.9.0..1.10.0
relgap registry update
```

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [relgap registry lint](/cli/registry/lint) | Validate registry entries against the schema |
| [relgap registry test](/cli/registry/test) | Run each source of a registry entry live and show what it produced |
| [relgap registry update](/cli/registry/update) | Download the newest registry entries from relgap's repository |
